deviations.topic: QKV input sharing and V orientation
deviations.amd: C64/C128 Q/K/V one K loop, A reused across six N16 accumulators, V computed directly as B operand.
deviations.r18: Adjacent N32 family segments combined into N64; C32 fourth segment correctly masked but matrix work padded; global FP16 QKV retained.
deviations.intel_current: Direct pack already fuses norm and packing; separate family programs remain.
deviations.conversion: Preserve current half norm/Q scale; no AMD FP8/math substitution.

deviations.known: Each program reads complete head K/V; logical requests/query programs double.
deviations.unknown: Actual DRAM increment, cache hits, and latency share.
More resident fragments/shared memory does not by itself establish measured occupancy loss.

deviations.conversion: Shared FP16 KV requires publication and end-reader barrier before AV alias, six WG barriers in proposed paired-SG design.
deviations.unsafe: Do not overwrite KV while another SG reads or return a cropped query before WG barriers.

deviations.amd: Packed FP8 conversions, byte output and RTZ pair helpers; historical gains with guarded arithmetic.
deviations.conversion: Reuse wide read/write organization at FP16 byte size; do not restore deleted quantization or AMD MODE/clamp semantics.
deviations.unknown: Intel vectorization/throughput must be measured; AMD W16_SMALL was not adopted.

deviations.amd: No explicit async multistage queue in the two includes. Active load hoist, independent QT chains, fragment reuse, compiler fences and restricted unrolling.
deviations.conversion: Optional two-slot next-K preloads are a new bounded Intel diagnostic, not a copied successful async pipeline.
deviations.unknown: Actual native load/wait overlap and benefit.

deviations.r18: LATENT, MLP, QKV global FP16 boundaries remain; split adds real ATT boundary and 16 attend launches versus r18 fused.
deviations.reference_limit: Accepted C256 already had intermediate boundaries; costs cannot be transferred between baseline and r15 reference.
deviations.unknown: Per-stage raw time and actual bandwidth.

deviations.known: All selected resources have zero spill; serial C64 admits BM32/w4; shared C64 rejects larger tiles with actual positive spills.
deviations.unknown: Residency, native DPAS issue efficiency, cache, clocks; metadata registers=0 is not zero usage.

deviations.intel_current: Real decoder gather callback cold binding remains separate from post body; native K8 RGB/history crop boundary is retained.
deviations.conversion: Any future grouped owner must preserve callee/weight/stream/frame/history ownership and real compiled-resource receipts.

deviations.known: Three profiles enable broad Swin and c64/c256 BranchAccum; baseline does not. Full and raw regressions are observed whole-arm results.
deviations.unknown: A-only/B-only per-stage causal effect; full minus raw is not CPU-exclusive time.
